plugins.name: uberdev
plugins.description: GitHub workflow commands + full Superpowers skill suite (brainstorm with visual companion, write-plan, execute-plan, subagent-driven-dev wave-based parallel execution, finish-branch, systematic-debugging, TDD, worktrees, parallel-agents, verification, code-review pair, writing-skills, using-uberdev primer) and PR review agents. /solve and /turbo dispatch autonomous agents via a platform-aware dispatch backend (Workflow-native solver fleets by default, with detached wezterm / background transports opt-in — cross-platform on macOS, Linux, WSL2, native Windows); /issue creates well-investigated, deduped issues.
